# Hickok & Kim, Inc.

> Hickok & Kim, Inc. is a boutique law firm in Los Angeles, California, founded in 2019 by partners Daniel J. Kim and Christopher D. Hickok. The firm represents individuals and businesses across California in nine practice areas and offers a free initial consultation. Services are available in English and Korean.

## Contact
- Website: https://hickokkim.com/
- Phone: (213) 373-7188
- Email: info@hickokkim.com
- Address: 2202 S. Figueroa St., #201, Los Angeles, CA 90007 (meetings by appointment)
- Hours: Monday to Friday, 9 AM to 5 PM; calls and emails usually answered the same day
- Service area: all of California, by phone, video, or in person in Los Angeles
- Free initial consultation: https://hickokkim.com/contact/

## Practice areas (organized by the moment a client is in)
When something goes wrong
- Personal Injury (Daniel J. Kim, contingency fee): https://hickokkim.com/practice-areas/personal-injury/
- Civil Litigation (Daniel J. Kim): https://hickokkim.com/practice-areas/civil-litigation/

When you're building something
- Business Law (both partners): https://hickokkim.com/practice-areas/business-law/
- Corporate Law (both partners): https://hickokkim.com/practice-areas/corporate-law/
- Outside General Counsel (both partners): https://hickokkim.com/outside-general-counsel/
- Trademarks (Christopher D. Hickok): https://hickokkim.com/practice-areas/trademarks/
- Cannabis Law (Christopher D. Hickok): https://hickokkim.com/practice-areas/cannabis-law/

When you're planning ahead
- Wills & Trusts (Daniel J. Kim): https://hickokkim.com/practice-areas/wills-and-trusts/
- Real Estate Law (Daniel J. Kim): https://hickokkim.com/practice-areas/real-estate-law/

The firm does not handle criminal law.

## Attorneys (both are Partners)
- Daniel J. Kim, Partner. California State Bar #314971 (admitted 2017); U.S. District Court, Central District of California. University of San Francisco School of Law. Personal injury, civil litigation, wills and trusts, real estate; shares business law, corporate law, and outside general counsel. Speaks English and Korean. https://hickokkim.com/attorneys/daniel-kim/
- Christopher D. Hickok, Partner. California State Bar #315726 (admitted 2017). University of San Francisco School of Law, J.D. 2016; UC Santa Cruz, B.A. Cannabis law and trademarks; shares business law, corporate law, and outside general counsel. Board member, Los Angeles County Bar Association Cannabis Section. https://hickokkim.com/attorneys/christopher-hickok/

## Fees and process
- Free initial consultation by phone or video.
- Fee structures: hourly, flat fee, or contingency depending on the matter. Personal injury matters are handled on contingency.
- Every engagement begins with a written retainer agreement and conflict check; invoices are itemized.
- Details: https://hickokkim.com/how-we-work/
